create_JSONSink: create a JSONSink instance to save detection data to a JSON file
open_JSONSink_file: open a JSONSink file for writing detection data with automatic directory creation
append_detections_JSONSink: append detection data with optional custom data to a JSONSink instance
write_and_close_JSONSink: write accumulated detection data to JSON and close the file
parse_detection_data_JSONSink: parse detection and custom data into per-detection row dictionaries with bounding box coordinates
